**How to play:** download `Homeparty-Cards-<version>-win.zip` below, extract it, and double-click `Homeparty Cards.exe`. Phones on the same Wi-Fi scan the QR code on the screen.

- The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: click **More info → Run anyway**.
- When Windows Firewall asks, allow access on **Private networks**.
- Phones can't connect? The game shows a "Can't connect?" help screen; the README's Troubleshooting section has more.
